reason: After thorough review of the 10-K filing excerpt, Crescent Energy Company (CRGY) does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The filing contains detailed operational, financial, and reserve information typical of an upstream oil and gas producer, including proved reserves data, production volumes, merger and acquisition details (Vital Energy, SilverBow, Ridgemar), and derivative positions. However, no market size estimates, serviceable addressable market figures, or TAM projections are provided by the company itself. As an exploration and production company, CRGY focuses on asset-level metrics and reserve quantities rather than market opportunity sizing.
